messages:
ash: Quick async standup for BlueMarlin renewal — noticed a spike in embedding latency in eu-west-1. p95 token latencies up to ~800ms for their search requests. What I did: pulled traces, captured metrics, opened ticket #CS-894, collected a sample payload. Blocker: need eng confirmation on fallback model vs. scale plan. Today: coordinate canary and customer comms.

maria: Thanks Ash. Customer renewal meeting next Tue — we need an ETA within 24h if possible. Added renewal owner to the ticket. Can someone confirm if this is a model/regeneration issue or infra?

liam: Looking. Saw abrupt rise in KV cache misses around 04:12 UTC. No infra maintenance shown in slate logs yet. Initial quick trace: ```
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.16 -> 0.08
batch_size: 128 -> 64 (shifted)
QPS: +40%
```
Suggests cache churn after embedding index re-gen or a new prefix distribution. I'll try a model-variant fallback canary in staging. @oncall-bot any scheduled jobs in eu-west-1?

oncall-bot: No scheduled infra maintenance or deploys in eu-west-1 between 1769120000 and 1769130000. No incidents reported.

jordan: If it's cache churn, short-term mitigations: 1) force warm-up for hot prefixes, 2) reduce max_batch_tokens to keep tail latency down, or 3) temporarily spin an extra Dedicated node for BlueMarlin. I can prep the node bump plan but need CS sign-off for cost.

maria: CS can approve a short Dedicated bump for the renewal window if eng thinks it will stabilize latency. Please estimate cost delta and rollback steps. Also, Ash — please craft a neutral customer note that we're investigating and may route to a temporary higher tier for stability.

liam: I'll run a canary fallback to previous quantized variant at 12:30 UTC and post results here. If that drops p95 back under 300ms, we can lean on model rollback. If not, Jordan's node bump is next.

ash: Thanks. Action items: 
- liam: run canary fallback (12:30 UTC) and post latency numbers
- jordan: draft Dedicated bump + rollback plan and rough cost estimate
- maria: prepare customer messaging and cost approval path
I'll update the customer after the canary. Ping me if you need access to BlueMarlin org creds. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll loop in finance if jordan posts numbers. Thanks everyone — will follow up in 3h or after canary.

liam: Posting canary result in this thread once done. Short note: if anyone needs the trace link — https://redwood.internal/traces/1769123456-sample
